title: Data Science
description: Learn how data is collected, prepared, analyzed, visualized, communicated, and applied to real-world problems.

title: Machine Learning
description: Learn the foundations of machine learning, including regression, classification, clustering, NLP, time series, and reinforcement learning.

title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Explore the foundations of artificial intelligence, neural networks, computer vision, natural language processing, deep learning, and intelligent systems.

title: Generative AI
description: Learn how modern generative AI systems work and how to responsibly build applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI security.

title: Cybersecurity
description: Learn core cybersecurity concepts including security principles, identity, networking, SecOps, AppSec, infrastructure, data, and AI security.
